verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document minting scoped or read-only API credentials for an agent or contractor. The closest item is the MCP server's split of read tools from write and delete tools, which lets the person connecting approve each category. That is an adjacent tool-approval control, not a scoped credential. The only documented integration API keys are for sending data into Customer.io, not for read-only analytics access.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send

citations.quote: Reads are separated from writes and deletes... so you can approve each category independently.
